title: BAW (Bulk Acoustic Wave) - Band 66 (AWS) for 5G NR Sub-6 GHz Front-End Module
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Jennifer Kim

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a BAW (Bulk Acoustic Wave) filter targeting Band 66 (AWS) for 5G NR Sub-6 GHz Front-End Module. The filter is designed on ScAlN on Si substrate with a target center frequency of 1335.0 MHz and bandwidth of 371.7 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the 5G NR Sub-6 GHz Front-End Module module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: BAW (Bulk Acoustic Wave)
- Frequency Band: Band 66 (AWS)
- Application: 5G NR Sub-6 GHz Front-End Module
- Substrate: ScAlN on Si
- Package: SiP (System in Package)
- Design Tool: Keysight ADS 2024
- Design Center: Newbury Park Design Center

This specification applies to all variants of the BAW (Bulk Acoustic Wave) design targeting Band 66 (AWS). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       1335.0 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       371.7 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 1.6 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 10.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 32.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 33.0 dB
Q Factor:               1223
Temperature Coefficient:-19.7 ppm/°C
Die Size:               0.7 x 1.1 mm
Wafer Size:             8-inch
Number of Resonators:   3
Electrode Material:     Pt/Al
Passivation:            SiO2/Si3N4 stack
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Keysight ADS 2024 and load the BAW (Bulk Acoustic Wave) template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: ScAlN on Si with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 1335.0 MHz, BW 371.7 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 1.6 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (SiP (System in Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (8-inch, ScAlN on Si).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Keysight N5227B PNA.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 4005 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 1.6 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 10.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 558 MHz offset >= 32.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 6 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 3.3 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +35 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 1000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 90%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2024-08-14
Devices Tested:         49
Insertion Loss (meas):  1.29 dB
Return Loss (meas):     11.9 dB
Rejection (meas):       35.1 dB
Isolation (meas):       38.2 dB
Q Factor (meas):        1223
Group Delay Variation:  2.2 ns
Power Handling:         +27 dBm
Die Yield:              87.8%

Result Classification:  NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The BAW (Bulk Acoustic Wave) design demonstrated below-target performance for Band 66 (AWS).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Package parasitic effects were consistent with 3D EM model predictions.
e) Cross-talk between adjacent filter channels was below -55 dB.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
